why: Locks two false positives measured on 2026-08-30. `openkartline/apps/web/src/App.tsx` line 521 was accused over `href="https://github.com/Navesz/openkartline"`, a footer link to its own repository; and `prumo/apps/server/src/db/migrations/20260825_0003_credentials.ts` was accused over twenty `doc: 'https://docs.fal.ai'` fields, a documentation catalog seeded into a table. A link is a link and data is data: neither one is an address the program calls, and neither one stops working when the deploy moves. The `fail` side is the `pass` side PLUS a request to a hard-coded address — the only difference is the defect, so no part of the accusation can come from the link or from the documentation field.
